DML.SELECT: SELECT role_id as "roleId", system_permission_id as "systemPermissionId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM conf.role_permissions WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.role_permissions (role_id, system_permission_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:roleId, :systemPermissionId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.role_permissions WHERE role_id = :roleId AND system_permission_id = :systemPermissionId
